summary.text: Steven Walker is a Republican state representative from Arkansas House District 27 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Walker has worked as a digital learning coordinator with the Arkansas River Education Service Cooperative.

paragraphs.text: Walker was born in Salem, Arkansas.
He earned an A.A. in general education from Ozarka College, a B.S. in mid-level education from Arkansas State University and an M.S. in educational leadership.
His career experience includes working as a digital learning coordinator with the Arkansas River Education Service Cooperative.
Walker assumed office in the Arkansas House on January 9, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session Walker was vice chair of the House Management Committee and also served on the House Education Committee, the House Agriculture, Forestry and Economic Development Committee, the House Advanced Communications and Information Technology Committee, the Joint Budget Committee and the Joint Energy Committee.
